source: api/lib/score.py @ fudfomo (private), pulled 2026-11-27; calibration fitted 2026-10-25 on ~3400 headlines (Hebrew + English)
notes: A factor scores a hard 0 when its best seed match stays below its match threshold - background similarity is never a finding.

paper.md v0.3 reliability note: the int8 model is NOT bit-reproducible across CPUs; a small number of borderline decisions are machine-dependent coin flips. The evidence margin no longer fully guards this.
The headline number is the MAX of the factors; the pressure family (clickbait/fud/fomo) and the content family (violence/attack/profanity) are never averaged together.
Word-boundary seed matching since Nov 2026: Latin seeds match on word boundaries; Hebrew seeds allow one leading prefix letter but must end on a word boundary.
